His work has led to interdisciplinary collaborations, including with Cedric Notredame on the development of the T-Coffee algorithm, which is widely used in multiple sequence alignment.

His contributions have had a lasting impact, as evidenced by his numerous citations and the standardization of methodologies in sequence alignment and analysis.
